exposure: Diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) measurements (fractional anisotropy (FA), mean diffusivity (MD))
outcome: Developing cyto/myeloarchitectural architecture (changes in T1w/T2w ratio, FA, MD)
cohort: The study included 78 preterm neonates from whom 92 magnetic resonance imaging scans were analyzed.
finding: The study characterized the developing cyto/myeloarchitectural architecture in preterm neonates using combined T1w/T2w ratio and DTI measurements, revealing distinct linear and parabolic trajectories, regional heterogeneity, and associations with 1-year language/cognitive outcomes and intraventricular hemorrhage.
gest_age: Preterm neonates, with imaging focused throughout the third trimester.
